Name: FERAL FORM
Main Effect:
Whenever you enter your Feral Form, you lose half your current Health and gain twice as much Shield.

You remain in your Feral Form until all Shield is gone or you take a Short Rest.

While in this form you have advantage on all attack rolls and your Claws & Teeth attacks are Empowered by 1.

In this form you are unable to use items, or abilities and spells that are not Feral Curse ones.

Name: FERAL RAGE
Main Effect:
Whenever you lose Health or spend Willpower, you have a chance to transform into your Feral Form.

Each time, make an Instinct roll with a difficulty of 8. On a failure the difficulty increases by 1 for your next roll. It resets to 8 on a transformation.

You can choose to willingly fail the roll.

Name: BEAST WITHIN
Main Effect:
When you become Feral Cursed, you choose a Carnivore Mammal. This beast represents how your ability manifests.

While your hands are empty, you can use the Claws & Teeth weapon. You learn a number of Novice Martial Moves equal to 2 + your Rank in Feral Curse, which you can use with Claws & Teeth.

Whenever you take a long rest, you can use your long rest action to change any number of learned Martial Moves.

At Rank 2, you can learn Adept Martial Moves, and at Rank 3, you gain access to Master Martial Moves.

Name: BESTIAL SENSE
Main Effect: You have advantage on Skill Checks related to using your 5 senses.

Name: FERAL HIDE
Main Effect: While you are in your Feral Form, your Armor is increased by half your Instinct, rounded down.

Name: CALL THE BEAST
Main Effect:
You stop holding it in. You enter your Feral Form without making a Feral Rage roll, and the difficulty of your next one resets to 8.

You lose half your current Health and gain twice as much Shield, as Feral Form says.

Name: BESTIAL FRENZY
Main Effect: You can now use two Martial Moves on the same Weapon Attack, or use one Martial Move just before a Weapon Attack reaction.

Name: BEAST AND DRIFTER
Main Effect:
While you are in your Feral Form you can use your own abilities and spells, whatever taught them to you.

Your hands are still a beast’s, so you remain unable to use items.
